procedure: scripts/check_compiled_forces.py. Default model, same initial weights, two molecules (5+4 atoms), energy and force squared loss. Each run records captured operations and parameter gradients. Native gradients means no learned operator was captured. The largest parameter relative error is the relative L2 norm of one whole parameter tensor.

controls.method: TECE, TACE, E2Former and E2Former-LSR set --e3nn-codegen fx; Geodite and AlphaNet set --match-rng, keeping default dropout probabilities.

related_checks.frozen_models: frozen_models_cpu.json records outputs against pre-refactor weights and inputs for all 58 native presets.
related_checks.vector_models: vector_force_inductor_cpu.json records corrected QuinNet gradients, ViSNet family controls, and the effect of auxiliary zero gradients on optimizer updates.

selected_outputs.method: Only E and Fa were returned to the caller. Gradients absent in eager and explicit zero in Inductor are recorded separately.

dpa4_normalization_precision.method: Diagnostic only. Keeping normalized float64 inputs in float64 in both implementations removes the E/F difference. The published preset normalizes in float32.

dpa4_fusion_disabled.method: Diagnostic only. Disabling fusion without changing the published normalization.

e2former_lsr.method: Fixed discrete fragment membership before the coordinate VJP; both methods use FX kernels.

dimenet_precision.method: Identical initial weights and coordinates. Relative L2 distances to fp64 eager. Near-cancelling elements can exceed elementwise tolerances even when the whole tensor agrees closely.

dpa3.method: Scoped single horizontal reduction during the forward and the weight backward of ordinary compiled CPU force training.
